title: Reference Set Dropzone Contract
description: Project-agnostic contract defining where operators can place reference images and how the system validates them against blueprint slots

contract_version.description: Version of the dropzone contract schema

blueprint_stage_id.description: Identifier of the blueprint stage this dropzone serves

dropzone_root_path.description: Root directory path where operators should place reference images

required_reference_slots.description: List of reference slots required by the blueprint

intake_manifest_path.description: Path where the intake manifest will be written

created_at.description: Timestamp when the contract was created

operator_instructions.description: Human-readable instructions for operators on how to use the dropzone

slot_id.description: Unique identifier for this reference slot

slot_role.description: Role this reference plays in the generation

required.description: Whether this slot must be filled before generation

min_dimensions.description: Minimum required dimensions for images in this slot

validate_existence.description: Whether to validate that files exist

validate_readability.description: Whether to validate that files are readable

validate_sha256.description: Whether to compute and validate SHA256 checksums

fail_on_missing_required.description: Whether to fail if required slots are not filled
